facts.fact: Home Affairs built a real-time employee verification portal for National Treasury, linked to the population register, to check government payroll records, going live 15 June 2026 per the department.
Home Affairs says its digital identity verification capabilities, linked to the population register, enable liveness tests and real-time biometric verification of employee records.
